channel.title: Weekly Worker — Imperialism & War (unofficial)
channel.description: Unofficial RSS feed of articles published by Weekly Worker — Imperialism & War.

item.title: Deterrents real and imagined
item.description: The present stand-off in the Gulf could run and run. Or there could be a sudden escalation. It is impossible to say, argues Yassamine Mather. Meanwhile, the situation inside Iran grows ever more desperate for working people
item.dc:creator: Yassamine Mather

item.title: Two takes on a genocidal nightmare
item.description: Anne McShane reviews Yuval Abraham and Rachel Szor (directors) NAZA. Daniele Rugo and Kyle Oakeson (directors) Life support. Both on general release
item.dc:creator: Anne McShane

item.title: Low expectations
item.description: Reportedly, it was the economy that sank Trump and the Republicans in the midterms … that and the unpopular Iran war. Yet, even with a clear majority in both houses, the Democrats are not going to bring about major change. And then there is the AI bubble, says Michael Roberts
item.dc:creator: Michael Roberts

item.title: A hidden supreme leader
item.description: Irrationalist belief in divination, spirit contact, haloes and jinn armies grows above. Below, living standards are falling and protests are reviving. Yassamine Mather looks at the two worlds that make up the Islamic Republic
item.dc:creator: Yassamine Mather

item.title: No clear outcome
item.description: There will be weeks of haggling, offers of bribes and ominous threats of all kinds. The Arab-majority parties might well be involved in this grubby business. But when it comes to the oppression of the Palestinians within and without Israel, no fundamental change should be expected, argues Yassamine Mather
item.dc:creator: Yassamine Mather

item.title: Modern wars, ancient myths
item.description: As the flame of war spreads across the region, Yassamine Mather looks at Saudi Arabia’s vulnerability, the misinformation surrounding the Houthis and Marco Rubio’s dangerous clash of civilisations nonsense
item.dc:creator: Yassamine Mather

item.title: Prisoners in soft captivity
item.description: Does British promotion of European rearmament against Russia amount to a viable alternative to US domination? Mike Macnair does not think so. Europe is incapable of independent action
item.dc:creator: Mike Macnair

item.title: The last man of ideas
item.description: Paul Demarty reviews Francis Fukuyama In the realm of the last man London 2026, pp304, £20
item.dc:creator: Paul Demarty

item.title: Three years of genocide
item.description: Millions marched worldwide, in London over 200,000. No one is fooled by Ed Miliband’s weasel words, not least because of the continued arms trade with Israel and the ban on Palestine Action, says Ian Spencer
item.dc:creator: Ian Spencer
